name: vitalview-research
description: Optical sensing research dashboard and reproducible neural network

scripts.format: prettier --write "*.{js,json,md}" server scripts tests web docs firmware/README.md .github/workflows .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "*.{js,json,md}" server scripts tests web docs firmware/README.md .github/workflows .prettierrc.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.js && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
